ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows quadrilateral QRST is a rhombus, with vertex Q at the lower left, R at the upper left, S at the upper right, and T at the lower right. There are two internal line segments in the figure: one from Q to S, and another from R to T, so QS and RT are the two diagonals of the rhombus. The problem gives the area of the rhombus A = 137.9 square meters, and RT = 12.2 meters. The area formula for a rhombus is A = (d1 × d2) / 2. Let d1 = RT = 12.2 and d2 = QS, then 137.9 = (12.2 × QS) / 2. Solving gives QS = 2 × 137.9 / 12.2 = 275.8 / 12.2 ≈ 22.6066, rounded to one decimal place according to the problem standard as 22.6 meters.

raw_record.question_text: Rhombus $QRST$ has an area of 137.9 square meters. If $RT$ is 12.2 meters, find $QS$.

method.method_draft: Identify from the diagram that QS and RT are the two diagonals of rhombus QRST. From the text, take the area as 137.9 square meters and RT as 12.2 meters. Use the rhombus diagonal area formula A = (d1*d2)/2, with d1 = RT and d2 = QS. Solve QS = 2A/RT = 2(137.9)/12.2, then round to get 22.6 meters.

method.method_draft: Use the diagram to see that diagonals QS and RT intersect inside the rhombus. Treat the diagonals of a rhombus as perpendicular bisectors, splitting the rhombus into four congruent right triangles. From the text, RT = 12.2, so each half of RT is 6.1; let half of QS be x. The area of one triangle is (1/2)(6.1)(x), so the total rhombus area is 4*(1/2)(6.1)(x) = 12.2x. Set 12.2x = 137.9, solve x = 11.3, and double it to get QS = 22.6 meters.

再推理：菱形的对角线互相垂直平分，因此 RT 被交点平分。已知 RT = 12.2 米，所以半条 RT = 12.2 ÷ 2 = 6.1 米。设半条 QS 为 x。四条半对角线把菱形分成四个全等的直角三角形，每个三角形面积为 (1/2)(6.1)(x)。所以菱形总面积为 4 × (1/2)(6.1)(x) = 12.2x。已知面积是 137.9 平方米，因此 12.2x = 137.9，解得 x = 137.9 ÷ 12.2 ≈ 11.3。QS 是两倍的 x，所以 QS ≈ 2 × 11.3 = 22.6 米。
